subject: Column names for draws across estimation techniques in Rstan

messages.author: 29ce8550baceaeb0
messages.subject: Column names for draws across estimation techniques in Rstan
parts:
Hi all - 

At the moment I'm estimating some models across several datasets. Depending on the size of the data, I'm using `sampling()`, `vb()` or `optimizing()`. Using them would be even easier if the outputs (parameter/generated quantities draws) were as similar as possible in terms of the column names. For instance, `optimizing()` preserves the square brackets in column names while `vb()` replaces square brackets with full stops. At the moment I'm parsing column names to re-create matrices/arrays from the draws for further simulation on new data, so it's important to me that naming is consistent.

This would seem to be a pretty small job and I'd be happy to make the changes myself and submit a pull request if someone could point me in the right direction (or give a good reason why it can't be done). 

Happy new year,
Jim

Ben would know best if that would be simple, but I agree this is something we need to do. At this point that would break backwards compatibility so it's probably something we'll do as part of the Stan and RStan 3 refactors when we make a lot of substantial improvements.

Jonah
